connectionError.need: keep your films and make their pictures, clips and sounds
connectionError.devHint: Development: `npm run dev` starts it, or run it yourself with `npm run server`, then retry.
connectionError.portTaken: Another program is using port {port}. Close it, then press {retry}.
connectionError.portOtherUser: Another person signed in to this computer has the app open, on port {port}. One copy runs at a time: they can quit theirs (its tray icon), then press {retry}.
connectionError.portReserved: Windows has reserved port {port} for another use (Hyper-V, WSL or Docker), so the app can't use it. Restarting the computer usually frees it; Troubleshooting in the help says how to keep it free.
connectionError.serverError: Its server stopped as it started: {error}

notFound.title: There's no page here
notFound.message: The address doesn't match any page of the app.

empty.title: No films yet
empty.message: Start a film from a story idea. Its AI plans the shots, and you can change anything it does.

fields.title: Title
fields.storyHint: A sentence, a page or a whole script. The AI plans the shots from it, and only from it.
fields.lookHint: How the film looks, in a few words — “moody 35mm film, overcast light”. Every picture of the film is painted with them.

delete.title: Delete this film?
delete.message: “{title}” and everything in it — its cards, shots, pictures, clips and sounds — will be deleted. This can't be undone.

film.gone: This film was deleted in another window.

hints.character: Who is in the film. A character's picture keeps their face and clothes the same in every shot.
hints.place: Where the shots happen. A place's picture keeps the set the same.
hints.prop: Objects that matter to the story, kept the same wherever they appear.
hints.look: A style shown as a picture, for shots that should share it.

fields.name: Name

descriptionHint.character: How they look: age, build, hair, clothes — the picture is painted from these words.
descriptionHint.place: What the place looks like, its light and its time of day.
descriptionHint.prop: What the object looks like: its shape, colour and material.
descriptionHint.look: The style: the light, the colours, the film stock, the mood.

fields.voiceHint: How they sound — “a low, weathered woman's voice, calm and dry”. Their lines are spoken in it.

cards.pictureAfterAdd: Add the card first; then paint its picture or take one from a file.

delete.title: Delete this card?
delete.message: “{name}” and its picture will be deleted. Shots that use it keep their own pictures and clips. This can't be undone.

settings.title: Settings

general.filmsHint: A new film's picture size, as wide (its tall and square shapes follow). Every first frame and clip is painted at the film's size; both sides are steps of 64.
general.cardsHint: The long side a card's picture is painted at, and the largest picture file a card takes.
general.windowsHint: The app open in more than one place at once — the desktop app, a browser on this server, a phone: how often each one looks for what the others changed. It shows their changes by itself.
general.checkSeconds: Look for other windows' changes every (seconds)
general.promptsTitle: The words pictures are painted from
general.promptsHint: Each kind of card's picture is painted from these words: {name} is the card's name, {description} its description and {look} the film's look.

settings.appearanceHint: How the app looks — applied at once and kept by the app.
settings.backupsHint: A backup holds everything the app keeps: your films with their pictures, clips and sounds, your settings and your AI setup. Downloaded models aren't in it — they download again. Exported films aren't in it — they are made again from the clips.
settings.logsHint: What the server and this window reported, newest last.

about.blurb: A free AI film studio on your own computer: the AI plans the shots, paints the cast, sets and props, makes the clips with their voices, music and sound, and joins them into a film — and you can change any step.
